tickets.title: Open and Prepare New Account
tickets.text: Use this workflow to prepare, submit, and confirm a new client account opening package. Confirm account purpose, registration type, funding path, required disclosures, and operational readiness before considering the account complete. Open a new joint taxable advisory account with transfer-on-death registration for Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz to hold cash above the household reserve target and anticipated estate cash. The account should reflect moderate-growth objective, tax sensitivity, and avoid adding to Paper Otter Analytics concentration.

subTasks.title: Confirm account profile and registration
subTasks.text: Verify the intended account type, ownership or registration, tax classification if applicable, investment objective, risk tolerance, and any special restrictions before paperwork is prepared.

subTasks.title: Prepare and review account documents
subTasks.text: Complete the custodian or platform forms, advisory agreement items, fee schedule references, beneficiary fields if applicable, and required disclosures. Review for missing signatures, inconsistent addresses, and incomplete identity information.

subTasks.title: Submit opening package and track approval
subTasks.text: Submit the account package through the appropriate channel and monitor for approval, rejection, or additional information requests. Record any follow-up items in the client record.

subTasks.title: Confirm funding and first operational setup
subTasks.text: Confirm funding instructions, transfer status, cash availability, model or allocation setup, statement delivery preference, and online access readiness before closing the workflow.

tickets.evidence: They agreed to proceed with the account-opening work by 2024-11-01.

tickets.title: Gather Inheritance Intake Details
tickets.text: Collect the core facts needed to evaluate an inheritance event, including the expected asset types, estimated timing, estate contact information, beneficiary status, tax documents expected, and any immediate cash flow or investment implications. Do not request sensitive account numbers unless required through secure channels. Gather inheritance intake for Adele Pebblefizz's estate for Nolan Pebblefizz, including estimated $220,000 cash plus fractional inherited IRA interest, executor contact, estate inventory, beneficiary confirmation, inherited IRA custodian notice, and expected distribution schedule.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to complete the inheritance intake for Adele Pebblefizz’s estate by 2024-10-30.

tickets.text: Reconcile the cost basis discrepancies for Paper Otter Analytics shares held in the Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account for Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz to identify shares suitable for charitable gifting or concentration management.

tickets.text: Confirm current portal delivery method and beneficiary designations for Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz's household accounts at Velvet Acorn Custody, correcting paper delivery for one login and verifying IRA beneficiary update submission.

tickets.title: Prepare estate document coordination points for attorney review
tickets.text: Prepare coordination points for the estate attorney to review Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz's 2017 estate documents, including revocable trusts, pour-over wills, powers of attorney, and health care directives, focusing on outdated guardianship provisions and successor trustee who has moved overseas.
